snippet.title: Amiga Longplay  Eliminator
snippet.description:
http://www.recordedamigagames.org

Played By: Kodoichi

Probably the best surprise ending ever. I played it using the Tosec version "Eliminator (1989)(Hewson)[cr BS1][h WindowsKiller]" in hope it had something fixed, but now think a "fuckings to Hewson, Bamiga Sector 1 and WindowsKiller" is absolutely appropriate. Wasted about five hours for this huge disappointment. -
